calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM dim_date ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    wo.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON wo.web_order_id = fsl.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN fsl.net_amount ELSE 0 END) 
        / SUM(fsl.net_amount),
        2
    ) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON wo.web_order_id = fsl.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    fulfilment_type,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line fsl
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE fsl.receipt_id = fact_web_order.web_order_id
        AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
        AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
)
GROUP BY fulfilment_type
ORDER BY fulfilment_type
